contentHtml:
New Jersey: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA (Glenmark), has announced the launch of Axitinib Tablets, 1 mg and 5 mg. This product is an Authorized Generic version of INLYTA1 (axitinib) tablets.

According to IQVIA® sales data for the 12-month period ending September 2026, U.S. annual sales of INLYTA® Tablets were approximately $538.4 million*.

“The launch of Axitinib Tablets reinforces Glenmark’s commitment to expanding access to quality, affordable medicines for patients in the United States,” said Marc Kikuchi, President & Business Head, North America. By adding this important product to our portfolio, we continue to strengthen our focus on addressing the evolving needs of patients and healthcare providers.”

1INLYTA® is a registered trademark of Pfizer Inc.

*IQVIA® National Sales Perspectives: Retail & Non-Retail, September 2026

Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Ltd. is a global, research-led pharmaceutical company with a unique focus on innovation and accessibility. We pioneer transformative breakthrough therapies that aim to redefine treatment while expanding access to high-quality and affordable medicines for patients around the world. With 11 world-class manufacturing facilities across four continents, supported by six cutting-edge R&D centres, and a commercial footprint in 80+ countries, we deliver a diversified portfolio across branded, innovative, generics, and consumer health products, with a focus on respiratory, dermatology, and oncology. Scrip 100 positions Glenmark among the Top 100 biopharmaceutical companies globally by pharmaceutical sales for 2024.
